title: Ladder: tank level control with interlocks
summary: Fill the tank to the high level switch, then drain it to the low level switch. Interlock contacts keep the inlet valve and the drain pump from ever running together and protect the pump from running dry, even when an operator presses Start at the wrong moment.
objectives: Express interlocks as normally closed contacts in ladder rungs
Protect a pump against dry running with a level switch
Use level switches to change between process steps
instructions: Start opens InletValve (self-holding); the valve closes at LevelHigh and on Stop (StopPB FALSE).
When the tank is full (LevelHigh), DrainPump starts and holds itself until LevelLow: LevelLow is TRUE while the level is below the low switch.
Interlock: InletValve never opens while DrainPump runs, and DrainPump never runs while InletValve is open.
Stop switches the drain pump off too.
hints: An interlock is a normally closed contact on the other output in each rung.
Dry-run protection: a normally closed contact on LevelLow in the pump rung.
The valve needs 1.5 s to close; the level keeps rising a little meanwhile.

criteria.title: Start opens the inlet valve
criteria.onFail: InletValve did not open after Start.

criteria.title: Full: the valve closes and the pump starts
criteria.onFail: At LevelHigh the valve should close and the drain pump start.

criteria.title: The pump stops at the low switch
Valve and pump never run together
criteria.onFail: InletValve and DrainPump were on together: interlock each output against the other.

criteria.title: Start does not interrupt draining
criteria.onFail: Pressing Start while draining should change nothing.

criteria.title: Stop closes the valve
criteria.onFail: After Stop both the valve and the pump should be off.
